hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/packages/mosaic" && { git diff --name-only --relative --diff-filter=d HEAD -- src; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- src; } | grep -E '\.tsx?$' | xargs -r pnpm exec eslint --quiet --no-warn-ignored >&2 || exit 2

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d HEAD -- packages/swingset/src; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- packages/swingset/src; } | grep -E '\.tsx?$' | xargs -r pnpm exec eslint --quiet --no-warn-ignored --rule 'import/no-unresolved: off' >&2 || exit 2
